text:
Marta (CS): FYI renewal for CustomerCo is blocked. They accepted the 12mo pricing but finance put a credit hold. PO will arrive but vendor code mismatch + e-sign recipient doesn't match signer on PO :/
Josh (Account Exec): Ugh. Do we have the PO yet? who is the signer on customer's side?
Ava (Ops @CustomerCo): Hey all — PO is coming from procurement@customerco.com, signer is CFO (Danielle). Their vendor code is `CUST-UK-998` which doesn't match our vendor `CustomerCoGlobal`. Procurement insisted on the vendor code being exact for AP.
Sam (Finance): We can accept `CUST-UK-998` but need vendor code on the invoice to match. Also credit hold means we need explicit payment approval. Can we get Dan to sign with the same email as on the PO?
Marta (CS): Problem: DocuSign envelope was sent to `billing@customerco.com` (ops), not Danielle. docusign-bot. Can we re-route without restarting the whole process?
docusign-bot: Envelope 0xA3F2 status: completed by billing@customerco.com. Signer email differs from PO signer. Recommended action: "Correct recipient or obtain delegated signer attestation."
Eli (Legal): If billing person signed but PO signed by CFO, we need a quick attestation email from CFO referencing the signer's authority to sign. That will close the audit trail without redlining the contract.
Josh (Account Exec): Quick proposal: 1) Ask CFO to send one-line attestation to procurement@redwood.com referencing envelope `0xA3F2` and PO `PO-2026-045`. 2) Finance issues invoice with `CUST-UK-998` vendor code. 3) We clear credit hold after PO + attestation. Thoughts?
Ava (Ops @CustomerCo): Danielle can do that but legal insists on the signature page being attached to the PO. She can send attestation and attach the PO. Will that satisfy you?
Sam (Finance): Yes — attestation email + attached PO with vendor code is sufficient for our AR team to release. We'll mark the credit hold cleared once AP confirms remittance path.
Marta (CS): I'll draft the attestation template to speed this up. Putting below — feel free to copy/paste:
```
Subject: Attestation of delegated signer for PO-2026-045
Hi Redwood team,
I, Danielle Mercer (CFO), confirm that Jane Billing at CustomerCo is authorized to sign Redwood contract envelope 0xA3F2 on behalf of CustomerCo. Attached: signed PO (PO-2026-045) with vendor code CUST-UK-998.
Regards,
Danielle
```
Eli (Legal): Good. Also ask them to include a scanned signature or typed name and title in the email body for our record.
Josh (Account Exec): I'll ping Danielle directly. Marta — can you post the attestation template in the customer thread and cc procurement@redwood.com?
Marta (CS): On it. I'll also attach a copy of the executed signature page we have and highlight the envelope id.
Ava (Ops @CustomerCo): Danielle says she'll send attestation within 2 hours and attach PO. She asked if we can start the onboarding provisioning before finance clears — they want a partial dev seat enablement.
Sam (Finance): We can allow staging access (no production keys) on our trust boundary, but full provisioning requires cleared PO. I'll confirm the exact gating rule with infra.
Marta (CS): Action items: Josh -> get Danielle to send attestation; Ava -> attach PO and confirm signer name; Sam -> confirm what staging access looks like; Eli -> confirm attestation language acceptable; Marta -> send template and include procurement@redwood.com. I'll update thread when attestation received. :thumbsup:
Josh (Account Exec): I'll update after call with Danielle (in 20m).
Ava (Ops @CustomerCo): Thanks team. Appreciate the flexibility.
Eli (Legal): If any changes to the contract page required, flag me immediately.
Marta (CS): last update: Danielle emailed attestation at 1768882100, attached PO, finance cleared credit hold at 1768882144. Moving to invoicing. Closing thread once invoice sent. :white_check_mark:
